hook.name: PegasusFairLaunchHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for Fair Launch pools that charges a fee on every swap via afterSwap with return delta, splitting proceeds among protocol, creator, and a buyback-and-lock vault. Applies a time-decaying anti-snipe tax on early buys; accrued memecoin fees are batched and converted back to the quote currency via internal swaps during periodic fee sweeps.
